scenes.name: PATH AND LOOPS
lines: Which rows of points can support a matrix with no hidden spectral obstruction? For even order, any nonempty loop set works.
哪些带自环的路径能支持没有隐藏谱障碍的矩阵？偶数阶只要自环集非空就可以。
At odd order, at least one loop must occupy an odd position, counting from an endpoint.
奇数阶则必须至少有一个自环位于从端点起编号为奇数的位置。
The manuscript credits Carptopus with the earlier full criterion. Here we explain the explicit integer construction.
原文把完整判据的早期证明归于 Carptopus；这里解释明确的整数构造。

scenes.name: THE MATRIX TEST
lines: A matrix records a weight at each arrow and loop, and zero everywhere else. Opposite arrows may have equal weights.
矩阵在箭头与自环处记录权重，其余位置为零；相反方向的箭头可以取相同权重。
The property, called nSSP, rules out every nonzero real test matrix that vanishes on these positions and whose transpose commutes with the original matrix.
nSSP 排除所有非零实测试矩阵：它在这些位置为零，且其转置与原矩阵交换。

scenes.name: DELETE THE LOOPED POINT
lines: Take five points with a loop at the center. Removing that point leaves two branches with two points each.
取五点路径，仅中心有自环；删掉中心后，左右各剩一条两点支路。
With unit weights, both branches have eigenvalues minus one and one. Their spectra collide, and the matrix fails.
单位边权使两支路的特征值同为负一和一；两边谱相交，矩阵失败。
Change the two left weights to three. The branch spectra become minus three and three, versus minus one and one. Now they are disjoint, and the matrix succeeds.
把左侧两条边改成三，支路谱成为正负三与正负一；谱不相交，矩阵成功。

scenes.name: SEPARATE THE SPECTRA
lines: In general, an admissible loop leaves at least one branch of even length. Such a branch has no zero eigenvalue.
一般地，可用自环会留下至少一条偶长度支路；它没有零特征值。
For an even branch of length d, give its edges weight d plus one, and the other side weight one.
偶支路长为 d 时，该侧边权全取 d 加一，另一侧全取一。
Every scaled eigenvalue has absolute value greater than two. The other branch stays strictly between minus two and two.
放大侧特征值的绝对值全大于二；另一侧仍严格位于负二与二之间。

scenes.name: RECOVER EVERY CHANGE
lines: Branch characteristic polynomials follow a recurrence, with only even powers or only odd powers.
支路特征多项式满足递推，只含偶次项或只含奇次项。
The nonzero loop separates the equation for zero first-order change into these two parities. Coprime branch polynomials force each branch variation to vanish.
非零自环把一阶变化为零的方程分成两种奇偶部分；支路多项式互素，迫使各自的变化为零。
Running the recurrence backward recovers every edge change. In eigenvector coordinates, this detects every commuting test matrix and forces it to be zero.
沿递推向后恢复每条边的变化；在特征向量坐标中，这能检测每个交换测试矩阵，并迫使它为零。

scenes.name: ADD THE OTHER LOOPS
lines: Start with this integer matrix and one loop. Add tiny positive weights at the other required loop positions.
从这个整数单自环矩阵出发，在其余要求的自环位置加入微小正权重。
The test is a full-rank linear system, so sufficiently small changes preserve the property.
测试是一个满秩线性系统，因此充分小的改变保持该性质。
Choose the new weights as one over a sufficiently large integer N, then multiply everything by N. Every nonzero entry is now a positive integer.
让新增权重为充分大整数 N 的倒数，再把整体乘以 N；全部非零项便都是正整数。

scenes.name: EXACT SCOPE AND CREDIT
lines: Lean proves exact real existence at every positive even order and every nonempty loop set, testing all real matrices.
Lean 证明每个正偶数阶与非空自环集都有精确支撑的实数见证，测试取遍全部实矩阵。
Symmetry, positive integrality, the odd-order extension, and the single-loop spectral equivalence have written proofs in this manuscript.
对称、正整数性、奇数阶扩展及单自环谱等价关系，在本论文中有书面证明。
For unit edges, a single loop at position ell succeeds exactly when ell and n plus one are coprime. Allowing one successful matrix does not require every matrix to succeed.
单位边权时，单环位置 ell 与 n 加一互素恰好保证成功；允许一个成功矩阵不等于要求所有矩阵成功。
